meta.name: Apple Wallet (iOS 26)
meta.source: Apple Wallet on iPhone, iOS 26: home card stack, card detail (Digital ID), boarding pass detail, permission sheet, app icon. Press screenshots (9to5Mac, WWDC 2025) plus Apple's App Store promo images.
meta.use: The visual bar for Jotful's reskin: thoughts become passes. Jotful borrows Wallet's system, never its marks.
not_copied: Apple logo and Apple Card/Cash marks
bank, airline and loyalty artwork on the cards
SF Pro (system font is used at runtime on iOS; the web fallback is -apple-system/Inter)

soul.one_line: A pale grey page holding a deep stack of solid, saturated cards, each showing only its top strip, with big black titles and white glass buttons.
soul.lineage: Physical wallet and passbook; iOS grouped-list system; Liquid Glass controls (iOS 26).
soul.read_distance: Arm's length: the stack of coloured strips reads as Wallet from 3 metres.

colors.name: system grey
colors.note: sampled #999BA8 on anti-aliased text; system grey inferred

colors.name: one saturated, full-bleed finish per card: deep navy #081F49, cobalt #0066CA, carbon #171717, warm yellow, iridescent white
system blue (only on a primary sheet button)

banned_behaviours: No brand colour in chrome: colour lives inside cards only.
No gradients on the page or on buttons; gradients only as a card's own finish.
No coloured text on the page except system blue links.

treatment.tracking: tight on large title (-0.4pt); caps labels +0.6pt
treatment.case: Sentence/Title case for titles; ALL CAPS only for small field labels on cards (BOARDS, GATE, PASSPORT VERIFIED)
treatment.numerals: proportional; big values right-aligned in the card header

space.margin_pct: page side margin ~5.5% of width (≈22pt on 393)
space.stack_strip_pct: each stacked card shows 25% of its height (≈54pt of 218pt)
space.header: large title baseline ≈ 60pt below the status bar; header buttons 44pt, vertically centred on the title
space.rhythm: panels below a card sit 16pt under it; panel inner padding 16–20pt

surface.edges: card radius ≈ 3.3% of card width (≈11–12pt); panels and tiles 20–24pt; buttons fully round
surface.elevation: cards: hairline-free, a soft shadow only on the front/open card; stacked cards separate by colour edge alone
surface.texture: cards carry their own finish: flat colour, brushed/metal sheen, art, or iridescent white; the page has none
surface.glass: iOS 26 header buttons are white glass circles/capsules with a faint shadow; grouped capsule for Search + More
surface.iconography: SF Symbols, regular weight, black on glass; coloured only inside tiles (one coloured glyph top-left)

signatures.how: Cards 88% wide stacked top-down; each card except the last shows only its top 25% strip; the strip shows the card's title top-left and one value top-right.
signatures.never: Never space cards apart like a list; never show two full cards.

signatures.how: 34pt bold black title top-left; on the right one 44pt glass circle (+) and one glass capsule holding two icons (search, more).
signatures.never: No centred nav titles, no tinted buttons.

signatures.how: Every card is a solid object with its own full-bleed colour/finish; white text on dark finishes, black on light ones.
signatures.never: No two adjacent cards in the same finish.

signatures.how: Title or wordmark top-left (22pt semibold), value or caps meta top-right; small caps field labels (11pt) over values (17pt) in rows.
signatures.never: No centred card text except a code/QR block.

signatures.how: Opening a card shows it full size near the top under X and (i) glass circles; below it white rounded panels (20–24pt radius) with rows and a full-width light grey capsule button.
signatures.never: No chrome over the card face.

signatures.how: Two-up white tiles under a pass: one coloured SF Symbol top-left, 15pt semibold title, 13pt grey subtitle.
All colour lives in cards; page, panels and buttons are greyscale.
signatures.never: No colourful backgrounds, no accent bars in chrome.

weird_move.name: Cropped on purpose
weird_move.what: Each stacked card is cut off by the next one mid-artwork and sometimes mid-word (BONVOY 'BOUNDLESS' sliced). The design accepts clipped content as the price of the stack.
weird_move.rule: Exactly at the strip line, the next card covers the previous one; only the header row must stay readable, everything below it may be clipped.
weird_move.never: Never shrink or ellipsize the header row to avoid the clip; never fade the overlap; never fill the clipped zone with decorative filler text: it holds the card's real art or its next line of content.

archetypes.anatomy: large title + glass buttons; deep stack starting ~24pt under the title; last card fully visible; with many cards the stack runs past the bottom edge (scrolls), no empty page under it
X and (i) glass circles; full card; white panel(s) with rows; full-width grey capsule; optional two-up action tiles
header row (logo left, meta right), big primary values, caps field row, code block centred
illustration band on a tinted top, bold 20pt title, grey body, blue filled capsule + white capsule at the bottom

motion.easing: spring, no bounce for stack; light bounce on card open
motion.entrances: opening a card lifts it out of the stack and slides the others down off screen
motion.never_moves: no fades between cards, no parallax on the page

voice.headline_shape: Title Case on buttons and panels (How to Use, Share Flight Tracker)

bans: No colour on the page, panels or buttons; colour lives inside cards only.
No borders or hairlines around cards or tiles.
No fully visible cards in the stack except the last one.
No gradients outside a card's own finish.
No serif or display fonts in chrome.
No more than 4 type sizes in one frame.
No dark page in light mode; the page is cool pale grey, never cream or white.

tests.check: Page background is cool pale grey (#F0EFF5–#F2F2F7), not white or cream.
Large title is ≥ 32pt bold near-black, top-left.
Header controls are white glass circles/capsules (no tint, no border).
Cards are 85–90% of screen width, radius 3–4% of card width.
In the stack, each covered card shows 22–28% of its height and its header row is fully readable.
Every card has a distinct solid finish; no two adjacent cards share one.
Colour outside cards covers under 2% of the frame (system blue only).
No borders or hairlines on cards, tiles or panels.
Content below a card's header row is clipped by the next card at least once (the weird move is present).
No more than 4 type sizes in the frame.
Blind side-by-side with reference/stack.jpg: a viewer says 'Wallet' within 2 seconds.

gaps_found: Round 1 (2026-10-18): close at a glance (page, title, glass buttons, strip height, finishes all right). Gap 1: the builder filled the clipped zone with repeated spaced-caps filler text; in Wallet the clipped part is the card's own art or the second line of its wordmark. Added to weird_move.never.
Round 1: the rebuild ends the pile with empty page below; Wallet's stack runs to and past the bottom edge when there are many cards. Added to stack-home anatomy.

uncertain: Secondary grey (#8E8E93) inferred from system default; sampled text was anti-aliased.
Card radius 11–12pt estimated from a press image, not measured on device.
Strip height 25% measured on one screenshot at one stack depth; Wallet may compress strips as the stack grows.
Dark mode not captured; Jotful is light only for now.
